classification.difficultyReason: Plot the supplied functions and identify the direction and size of the constant vertical shift.

content.prompt: Use graphing software to sketch the family of functions $y=e^x+c$ for $c=\pm1,\pm2$ and describe the effect of varying values of $c$ on the shape of the curve.

answer.short: Adding $c$ shifts the curve up by $c$ units if $c>0$ or down by $|c|$ units if $c<0$. The shape stays the same.
answer.worked: Plot $y=e^x+c$ for $c=-2,-1,1,2$ on the same axes. Each curve has $y$-intercept $1+c$ and horizontal asymptote $y=c$. At each $x$, adding $c$ changes the height by the same amount, so the curve translates vertically and keeps its shape.
